theme: Changeover day, Croatia five days out.
greeting: Moving houses today with the St. Pete Ranch ahead and one Brunswick call in the middle. The real weight sits five days out: Croatia, and a handful of P1s still open before you fly.

needsAttention.title: Conor Kehoe call on PRI stewardship
needsAttention.detail: 10 AM Zoom with Conor Kehoe on PRI sustainability and stewardship. A governance networking conversation worth arriving at with two or three current thoughts on where the PRI's stewardship agenda is heading.

needsAttention.title: Confirm checked bags on the Croatia ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags. It is cheap to fix online now and costly at a Eurowings counter, so confirm on the operating carrier's site and buy bags if needed before you fly the 8th.

needsAttention.title: Book the Cavtat night and transfer for Sept 19
needsAttention.detail: The last Dubrovnik night in Cavtat plus the Komolac transfer have to be booked from dry land. Charter connectivity is poor, so this closes before the Sept 8 departure, not on the 19th.

needsAttention.title: Hold or book the Sept 20 rental car
needsAttention.detail: A refundable Full Size SUV for TPA Sept 20 to Oct 5 is a hedge unless Mike's car is confirmed en route. The call lands Sept 7, the day before Croatia.

needsAttention.title: Pack the travel larder bin for the move
needsAttention.detail: Today is the House 1 to House 2 changeover, and the larder bin was meant to be built before it so the first migration is a test run while there is still time to fix it.

schedule.title: House 1 to House 2 changeover
schedule.detail: Kenwood checkout, St. Pete Ranch check-in

flagged.title: Mastercard exec wants to connect
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn invite from Mastercard's head of government engagement is sitting unanswered.

flagged.title: Caregiver applied on Care.com
flagged.detail: Gabriella R. applied to your posted job.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters, promotions, and Airbnb host chatter.
inbox.clear: The Kenwood reservation thread has wrapped up, nothing owed there.

resolved.title: Kenwood stay wrapped up
resolved.detail: The Airbnb host closed out the Kenwood reservation thread and reacted to your last message; nothing owed.

recipe.title: Roasted kabocha squash
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the first winter squash to the market — kabocha roasts sweet and nutty as the season turns.

Buy EU plug adapters and a US power strip

acts.line: Checkout at Kenwood, then the move to the St. Pete Ranch with the larder bin riding along.
One real block: the 3:30 Brunswick call with Lauren, tucked inside the changeover.
Settling the new place, with Conor Kehoe's PRI call waiting at 10 tomorrow.
